question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Itself**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Themself- Used instead of ‘himself’ or ‘herself’ to refer to a person of unspecified sex.

 
 
• *Example: No one perceived themself to be in a position to hire such a man.*
 
 
 
• Itself- Used when the subject of the verb is "it" and the object is the same thing, animal, situation, or idea.
 
 
• *Example: The cat licked itself all over. *
 
 
 
• **Herself**- Used to refer to a female object of a verb, that is the same person or animal as the subject of the verb.
 
 
• *Example: She kept telling herself that nothing was wrong.*
 
 
 
• Himself- Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a male person or animal previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.
 
 
• *Example: The steward introduced himself as Pete.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, 'itself' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• Thus option 2 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: *Neither of the farmhouses are attached to a farm these days; the land has been sold and is managed by somebody in an office somewhere who has little interest in the village **itself.*
